response.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT f.rating, COUNT(*) AS rentals FROM rental re JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = re.inventory_id JOIN film f ON f.film_id = i.film_id GROUP BY f.rating), a AS (SELECT AVG(rentals) AS avg_all FROM r) SELECT AVG(r.rentals) AS avg_rentals_above_avg_ratings, AVG(r.rentals - a.avg_all) AS avg_diff_above_overall FROM r CROSS JOIN a WHERE r.rentals > a.avg_all
